clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Tonga Runetotem studies strange changes in the Barrens' oasis waters. Fissures beneath the pools may be changing the creatures that live there, and he asks you to bring him shells from altered snapjaws.

Tonga Runetotem is searching for the cause of strange changes in the Barrens' oases. Though the savanna is dry, a handful of pools support fertile ground. Tonga found peculiar fissures beneath those waters, sending out potent energies. He does not know whether the force came from outside or rose from deep within the earth. Now he studies the creatures that drink from and live in the pools, hoping to learn what the fissures are doing to them.

You are sent to the Lushwater Oasis and the Stagnant Oasis to gather altered snapjaw shells. Snapjaws live in the shallows, where they take in the strange essence through food and exposure. Their carapaces have changed, offering Tonga a sign of how the fissures affect local wildlife. He hopes the shells will help him understand the disturbance before it spreads farther across Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your findings are incredible, friend. These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source. Or perhaps an inside one.
I want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.
Hunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases. Bring me their shells so I may examine them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How goes your collection? Did you get the shells?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. Studying the beasts of an area can tell much about the area itself. We shall see what tale these shells tell.
Please accept my gratitude for your aid... And perhaps you can use these coins. I find that I do not need them.
